title: 4 grizzly bears found responsible for killing mother and daughter in B.C.
summary: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says four grizzly bears have been destroyed in connection with an attack near Bella Coola that left a mother and daughter dead.

image.caption: Jennifer Balcarras and Selah Reed were killed in a grizzly attack near Bella Coola. (Submitted by Travis Reed)

blocks.text: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says four grizzly bears have been destroyed in connection with an attack near Bella Coola that left a mother and daughter dead.
Sow, 3 cubs, all destroyed, says B.C. Conservation Officer Service
The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says four grizzly bears have been killed in connection with an attack near Bella Coola that left a mother and daughter dead.
Forensic testing confirmed a sow and three cubs were actively involved in the attack that killed Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20.

items: Mother and daughter killed in suspected grizzly attack were 'two peas in a pod,' family says

blocks.text: In an update Tuesday, BCCOS Insp. Jeff Tyre said the attack likely involved predatory behaviour, which is considered "very rare."
"We hope the efforts of everyone who responded, as well as these findings, bring some measure of closure," he said.
The four bears captured over the weekend were not involved in the 2025 attack on a group of students and teachers, Tyre added.
